description: The launcher is a normal window now (§1): it dismisses nothing by itself — the close hides it to the tray from Rust — and showing it is Rust-side too (⌥Space, the tray, single-instance), so no capability is needed for either. Listening stays for the `theme-changed` broadcast. Dragging by the search panel (D155) needs start-dragging; double-click maximise is deliberately NOT granted.
